info.title: OMA LwM2M Thread Commissioning (joiner add) (Object ID 10484)

Thread_Commissioning_(joiner_add).label: Thread Commissioning (joiner add)
Thread_Commissioning_(joiner_add).description: This LwM2M Object enables commissioning (commissioner joiner add) of Thread devices on the Network. The target device must be have the "commissioner" and "joiner router" roles. Ex: "Border Router"

Joiner_eui64___discerner.label: Joiner eui64 / discerner
Joiner_eui64___discerner.description: Indicates the Extended Unique Identifier (EUI64) or discerner value that can be accepted by the thread commissioner. Use '*' to match any Joiner.

Joiner_PSK.label: Joiner PSK
Joiner_PSK.description: Indicates the Pre Shared Key (PSK/PSKd) Identity shared between thread device and thread commisioner.

State.label: State
State.description:
Provides the commisioner state as Enumerated type:
				0: Disabled
				1: Active

Pending_joiners_IDs.label: Pending joiners IDs
Pending_joiners_IDs.description: Reports the commissioner currently accepted (eui64 / discerner) IDs.

Start.label: Start
Start.description: Start the commisioning sequence with a default timeout. Using ot-br-posix, this is equivalent to issuing the "commissioner joiner add [Thread joiner eui64] [Pre Shared Key Identity]" command. Optionnal commissioning timeout in seconds can be specified using argument 0. Ex 0='60'
